company: Smitty Roofing and Remodeling & Chimney Sweep LLC

reviews.text: Simon was professional throughout our scheduled chimney sweeping service . He checked the chimney throat for visible buildup and carefully cleaned the accessible areas. He explained the work he completed and treated our home with respect.
reviews.author: Jacob M.

reviews.text: Had this company do some chimney repairs and some pointing around my front door. They did excellent work, and were very professional the whole time. Excellent communication throughout the process, as well.
reviews.author: Donnie W.

reviews.text: I had my roof replaced. it was done really well. Mark was great because he told me what he was going to do before he started working. He looked at the shingles replace the old part and then cleaned up.
reviews.author: Jeremy C.
